I was sat waiting on hold for 2 hours to be spoken to, being “first in queue” for 30 minutes and still getting nothing.
I had called a week prior presenting with chest pains, shortness of breath and inability to catch my breath after just speaking, a corse chest cough that was causing me to spit up blood and repeatedly vomit throughout the day. As
a nineteen year old girl, struggling to catch my breath and having a horrifically dry chesty cough was incredibly worrisome. I was informed I would be triaged and would hear back from the practice on any status updates or changes.

Any occasion in which I have had the misfortune of having to go to the practice in person I have been met with an irritated receptionist and severe lack of communication. As someone who worked as a dental receptionist and nurse for a year, I understand the frustrations and horrid members of the public you see daily, but walking in with a smile and greeting staff with a “good morning how are you!” and then being met with a monotone “name?” is just poor customer service.

Not a single person I have met has had a good thing to say about this practice and quite frankly, i’m not even sure how it still operates.
